reason: B proposes a physically plausible grain-heterogeneity mechanism for improving tensile strain hardening in an Al-free refractory alloy, whereas A unjustifiably transfers an Al-containing BCC/B2 phase-inversion mechanism and highly specific heat treatment to HfZrTiTa0.53. B remains under-specified and incorrectly treats the reported 13.5% terminal strain and WFeNiMo energy release as HfZrTiTa0.53 tensile/impact baselines, but its matched tests and falsification criteria make it the more defensible proposal.
